review_locator: PMCID:PMC3927127, Cytokine-Mediated Regulation of Plasma Cell Generation: IL-21 Takes Center Stage
primary_title: Loss-of-function mutations in the IL-21 receptor gene cause a primary immunodeficiency syndrome
decision_basis: The review identifies IL-21-induced AICDA expression, while the cited primary shows impaired AICDA induction in IL-21R-deficient human B cells stimulated with CD40L and IL-21.
limitations_preserved: Preserve CD40L co-stimulation and human IL-21R-deficiency context; supports IL-21-dependent AICDA output but does not establish IL-21 as the sole transcriptional driver or direct promoter occupancy.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC4770986, Interleukin-21 in the balance of immunity; PMCID:PMC4907214, Interleukin-21 signaling
primary_title: IL-21 and CD40L synergistically promote plasma cell differentiation through upregulation of Blimp-1 in human B cells
decision_basis: The cited primary shows IL-21/CD40L stimulation associated with increased IRF4 mRNA and protein during human germinal-center B-cell to plasmablast differentiation, with JAK/STAT inhibition reducing the response.
limitations_preserved: Preserve CD40L co-stimulation and human B-cell differentiation context; IRF4 induction is an output association and does not establish IL-21-only direct promoter activation.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC4770986, Interleukin-21 in the balance of immunity; PMCID:PMC4907214, Interleukin-21 signaling
primary_title: Interleukin-21 up-regulates interleukin-21 production in human T cells
decision_basis: The cited primary shows IL-21 increases IL21 RNA and protein in human activated CD3-positive T cells, with STAT3 recruitment to the IL21 promoter and STAT3 inhibition/siRNA reducing the response.
limitations_preserved: Preserve activated human T-cell and STAT3-dependent autocrine context; this is a cytokine output bridge with measured RNA/protein, not a claim that all IL-21 sources self-amplify.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC4969098, Interleukin-21 and T-cell differentiation; PMCID:PMC2754144, Th17 signal transduction
primary_title: IL-21 is produced by Th17 cells and drives IL-17 production in a STAT3-dependent manner
decision_basis: The cited primary shows IL-21 induces IL-17A expression and production in naive mouse CD4-positive T cells, while IL-21 blockade or STAT3 deficiency attenuates the Th17 output.
limitations_preserved: Preserve mouse CD4-positive T-cell/Th17 differentiation context and STAT3 dependence; IL-21 supports the output but does not establish a universal direct IL17A promoter edge.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC4969098, Interleukin-21 and T-cell differentiation; PMCID:PMC4907214, Interleukin-21 signaling
primary_title: IL-21 induces IL-22 production in CD4+ T-cells
decision_basis: The cited primary shows IL-21 induces IL-22 mRNA and protein in activated naive mouse CD4-positive T cells, with STAT3-dependent regulation and synergy with IL-23 or IL-1beta.
limitations_preserved: Preserve activated mouse CD4-positive T-cell and co-cytokine context; IL-21 supports IL22 output but does not imply a single direct IL22 promoter mechanism or SCI relevance.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC4969098, Interleukin-21 and T-cell differentiation; PMCID:PMC4907214, Interleukin-21 signaling
primary_title: IL-21 induces IL-22 production in CD4+ T-cells
decision_basis: The cited primary reports IL-21-associated Ahr expression during CD4-positive T-cell differentiation and links this response with STAT3-dependent IL-22 production.
limitations_preserved: Preserve the mouse T-cell differentiation and IL-22-sensitization context; AHR induction is not a claim of direct IL21 promoter activation or an independent terminal-TF edge.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC4969098, Interleukin-21 and T-cell differentiation; PMCID:PMC4907214, Interleukin-21 signaling
primary_title: IL-21 induces IL-22 production in CD4+ T-cells
decision_basis: The cited primary shows IL-21 upregulates Il23r expression in mouse CD4-positive T cells and that this receptor-sensitization program contributes to IL-23 synergy in IL-22 production.
limitations_preserved: Preserve IL-23 co-cytokine and mouse CD4-positive T-cell context; this is receptor-sensitization/output evidence, not proof of direct IL21-to-IL23R promoter binding.

primary_title: IL-21 induces IL-22 production in CD4+ T-cells
